_comment: 8.137.39.82:10443 is the production MTProto TCP port. DC 1 and DC 2 are that same address because debug builds start on DC 1 and release builds start on DC 2. seeds.testing is the MTProto testingEnvironment list, not staging; it uses this same production port. Port 11443 is the stated staging port and is not configured. Switching to it is unconfirmed. Do not put a hostname in seeds. Public keys are the PKCS#1 blocks from the iOS client, newest first; they match the Android PEM. Edit this file, then run python3 tellomi/apply_mtproto.py --generate.
